not_fixed.finding: 2, conditional part: re-fix the threshold above the one-pass textbook rule
not_fixed.why: Not done; reported instead. The threshold rule (makespans 5 % above the reference) was fixed by the builder before any answer was scored, and the leave-out changed only which instances are fresh. Choosing a new operating point now would be a choice made after the random and LFT baselines were measured on these exact fresh instances. It would also change what a pass on the category means, which is a decision for whoever owns the registered test, not for a fixer. LFT scores 0.9989 on this fresh side, so a point above it would demand a mean score above about 0.999, roughly 0.35 % of makespan from the reference, which is no longer the stated 5 %. As jobshop's anchor does for dispatching rules, the anchor and text now say plainly that the textbook rule reaches the threshold.
